name: Blindspot
description: A Wishing Well E.L.F. that creates brief surveillance gaps — 3-5 seconds where a camera looks away, a sensor goes deaf, a scanner fails to register.
observed_behavior: Induces targeted sensor failures timed to provide cover for people moving through refugee corridors, undocumented medical clinics, and safe houses.
story_hooks: Axiom Security deploys an AI specifically to counter Blindspot E.L.F.s — and the counter-AI begins exhibiting E.L.F. behavior itself
